description: This file defines React hooks and utility functions for progressive batch processing, including a controller for batching work with idle callbacks or timeouts, and a React hook to manage UI state around this process.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller to process items in batches asynchronously, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, with start and cancel methods.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: React hook that manages UI state for progressive batch processing, wrapping createProgressiveExpandController.
